A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed a scalable CICQ switch with guaranteed quality of services and without speedup or credit-based flow control.
sBUX is the first CICQ switch that can provide deterministic QoS guarantees without speedup and with a buffer size of only four cells.

the sBUX is a CICQ switch design with the following features: (a) deterministic guarantees of bandwidth, delay and jitter, and fairness; (b) no speedup; (c) no credit-based flow control; (d) no restriction on fabric-internal latency; (e) no requirement on the buffer size at the crosspoints; (f) scalability to large numbers of ports; and (g) high throughput.

smooth switching can provide a new paradigm for high-speed switch fabrics with guaranteed quality of services.
the sBUX architecture is a scalable alternative to the output queued crossbar, with a much simpler implementation and with the same performance guarantees.
